# Real Estate Career NS

> Answers about becoming a realtor in Nova Scotia, Canada, and building a real estate career there. Written by Rob Lough, Broker/Owner of Century 21 Optimum Realty, with 25 years in Nova Scotia real estate. Presented by Century 21 Optimum Realty. Not affiliated with the Nova Scotia Real Estate Commission (NSREC) or the Nova Scotia Association of REALTORS® (NSAR).

## Main sections

- [Getting licensed in Nova Scotia](https://realestatecareerns.ca/getting-licensed/): the five-step licensing path, costs and timelines, for people considering the career
- [Growing your career](https://realestatecareerns.ca/growing-your-career/): commission splits, compliance, tools and switching brokerages, for licensed agents
- [Licensing cost calculator](https://realestatecareerns.ca/tools/licensing-cost-calculator/): estimates the cost of getting licensed and the first year
- [All answers](https://realestatecareerns.ca/blog/): every article, newest first
